guard: a bare down of a legacy root whose stack is already stopped is a no-op in every presentation, and a root with no such evidence, a leftover process record or two registrations still refuses with one next step
why: A legacy root's own down removes its registration, so a second bare down used to refuse CONFLICT with no next step. The evidence that it is stopped is the broker configuration a start rendered there, or a space prepared there, with no registration and no process record left. Each mutation drops one part of that evidence or one answer, and the suite drives the in-process down from a planted root.
Every build is scoped to the @cotal-ai/cli dependency closure, as in down-unowned-broker.json.

mutations.name: a stopped legacy root is refused instead of answered
mutations.find: if (stopped) return nothingRunning(presentationOf(args.values), stopped, values["with-agents"] === true && values["dry-run"] !== true);
mutations.expectRed: a second bare down of a stopped legacy root says its stack is not running, names cotal up, and exits 0
mutations.cell: a second bare down of a stopped legacy root says its stack is not running, names cotal up, and exits 0

mutations.name: --json stays refused on a stopped legacy root
--with-agents on a stopped stack answers with the no-op
mutations.find: if (withAgents) throw new CommandFailure("refused", "LIFECYCLE_BLOCKED", "--with-agents needs the stack's running manager
mutations.replace: if (withAgents && false) throw new CommandFailure("refused", "LIFECYCLE_BLOCKED", "--with-agents needs the stack's running manager
mutations.expectRed: --with-agents on the stopped root refuses LIFECYCLE_BLOCKED, because no manager runs to stop its agents
mutations.cell: --with-agents on the stopped root refuses LIFECYCLE_BLOCKED, because no manager runs to stop its agents

mutations.name: a folder with no rendered broker configuration counts as stopped
mutations.expectRed: a folder that never had a stack refuses TARGET_NOT_FOUND and names where to run down
mutations.cell: a folder that never had a stack refuses TARGET_NOT_FOUND and names where to run down

mutations.name: a leftover process record does not stop the no-op
mutations.expectRed: a process record with no registration refuses CONFLICT, points at cotal status, and keeps the record
mutations.cell: a process record with no registration refuses CONFLICT, points at cotal status, and keeps the record

mutations.name: two registrations get the generic refusal
mutations.expectRed: two registrations for the root refuse CONFLICT, naming both, and point at space forget
mutations.cell: two registrations for the root refuse CONFLICT, naming both, and point at space forget
